item.title: Forres remembers – hundreds turn out to watch parade despite damp conditions
item.description: The rain cleared in time for the Remembrance Parade in Forres on Sunday 9 November. Hundreds of supporters lined the high street as the parade made its way from St Leonard’s Church to the war memorial. item.title: The Nicholson Building is demolished
item.description: The Nicholson Building on St Catherine’s Road has been demolished. Built in the late 19th century or early 20th, the building was originally the Forres Carriage and Motor Works.
